sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: Jina AI has released jina-ocr-v1, a visual document parser that converts PDFs, scans, tables, charts and invoices into Markdown. The model has 3.4B total parameters, with about 570M active per token, and builds on DeepSeek-OCR. A built-in FastMTP speculative decoding head drafts 3 tokens per step while keeping output lossless. It scores 91.14 on OmniDocBench v1.6 and 83.4 on olmOCR-Bench, and parses 2.57 pages per second on 1 A100. Weights are on Hugging Face under CC BY-NC 4.0, with hosted access through Jina Reader. The post Jina AI Releases jina-ocr-v1: A 3.4B MoE Document Parser With Built-In Speculative Decoding for Low-Budget GPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
